headlines.title: Ground stop ordered for all airports nationwide for ‘reasons of safety’
headlines.description: Much of the air traffic across the U.S. was shut down suddenly Friday after the Federal Aviation Administration ordered a nationwide ground stop for all departing flights “due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety.”

headlines.title: Tanker collides with a New Orleans riverboat
headlines.description: Watch live coverage from WDSU as rescue operations are underway after a tanker collided with a riverboat in New Orleans.

headlines.title: Commerce Secretary Lutnick agrees to testify about Nvidia
headlines.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick agreed to testify before Congress over national security concerns regarding the expanding Nvidia scandal. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor details bipartisan concern and White House reaction.

headlines.title: Rep. Lauren Boebert, conservative firebrand from Colorado, loses her race for re-election
headlines.description: The Colorado Republican changed to a more conservative district after a close re-election call in 2022. But this year’s blue tsunami has swept her out of office, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Pope Leo makes emotional return to his ‘beloved diocese of Chiclayo’
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV made a triumphant return to the Peruvian city of Chiclayo, where he served as bishop for and was affectionately nicknamed “Padre Roberto.”

headlines.title: Supreme Court to rule on Trump’s asylum ban
headlines.description: The Supreme Court agreed to decide whether President Donald Trump’s administration has the authority to ban asylum claims at the southern border.
